# roadmap.sh

> Community-driven learning roadmaps and career guides for developers across all specializations and skill levels.

roadmap.sh provides structured, step-by-step learning paths for various developer roles including frontend, backend, full stack, DevOps, data analytics, and AI engineering. The platform helps developers navigate their career progression with technology-focused guides covering languages like JavaScript, Python, Java, and frameworks like React and Vue.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Java
- React
- Vue
- HTML/CSS
- DevOps
- Machine Learning
- Career Guide
- Learning Path
- Skill Development
- Developer Roadmap
- Full Stack Development
- AI Engineer
- PostgreSQL

## Core Developer Roadmaps

- [Developer Roadmaps - roadmap.sh](https://roadmap.sh): Community-driven roadmaps and guides for Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, DevOps.
- [Frontend Developer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/frontend): Step-by-step guide to becoming a modern frontend developer with HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
- [Backend Developer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/backend): Step-by-step guide to backend development covering Python, Java, Ruby, PHP.
- [Full Stack Developer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/full-stack): Full stack developer learning path covering frontend and backend technologies.

## Specialized Career Paths

- [DevOps Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/devops): Career guide for DevOps engineers and SREs covering CI/CD and operations roles.
- [AI Engineer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/ai-engineer): Career guide for AI engineers covering machine learning, NLP, and computer vision.
- [AI and Data Scientist Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/ai-data-scientist): Learning path for AI and data scientists covering machine learning and data analysis.
- [Data Analyst Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/data-analyst): Learning path for data analysts covering Power BI, Excel, and data visualization.
